newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran, Iraq to swap remains of soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Iran, Iraq to swap remains of soldiers.

text.p: Iraq and Iran will swap the remains of soldiers killed during their 1980-1988 Gulf War, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said on Saturday.
IRNA said the exchange would take place at Shalamcheh border post on Monday. It did not say the remains of how many soldiers the two countries were to swap.
The countries have exchanged remains of many of their soldiers in the past and repatriated tens of thousands of prisoners of war.
But they have not yet solved all issues relating to the missing in action and the POWs, a dispute still hindering normalisation of ties between the former foes.
Iran has said 5,000 to 10,000 prisoners are held by Iraq. Baghdad denies holding any Iranian and says more than 20,000 Iraqis are still held by Iran.
